talents.name: Block
talents.description: Melee block chance: 2 / 4 / 6%. Doubled while wearing a shield.

talents.name: Whirlwind
talents.description: Spin once, striking enemies within 3 metres for 200% weapon damage.

talents.name: Impale
talents.description: For 10 seconds, your next basic swing stuns enemies it hits for 3 seconds. Bosses resist the stun.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
talents.description: Attacks and abilities restore 1 / 2 / 3% of actual damage dealt as vitality.

talents.name: Retaliate
talents.description: After a block, you have 5 seconds to activate. Your next basic swing within 10 seconds deals 150 / 200% weapon damage. One activation per block.

talents.name: Rampage
talents.description: For 10 seconds: attack 20% faster, move 20% faster and take 10% more damage.

talents.name: Bladestorm
talents.description: Spin for 6 seconds. Strike enemies within 3 metres for 100% weapon damage once each second. Immune to stun and movement impairments. You may move, but cannot make basic attacks or Leap.

talents.name: Leap
talents.description: Leap forward up to 10 metres. Solid obstacles stop your leap.

talents.name: Unshackled
talents.description: Remove roots, slows and knockback. Does not remove stun or knockdown. Can be used while rooted, but not stunned.

talents.name: Iron Constitution
talents.description: Vitality granted by equipment increased by 5 / 10 / 15%. Does not change base vitality or potion healing.

talents.name: Elemental Resolve
talents.description: Remove poison, fire and frost effects. Immune to damage and effects of those elements for 3 / 6 seconds.

talents.name: Fleetfooted
talents.description: Enemy hit chance reduced by 3 / 6 / 9 percentage points. Includes a chance to evade arrows that physically reach you.

talents.name: Blood and Breath
talents.description: Above 80% vitality: move 20% faster. Below 20%: heal 1% of maximum vitality each second. Neither effect at 20–80%.
